points_doc: eye = shackle eye centre on the rest frame (the chain from the rail ends here; in sway frames it moves <= 2px); tip = hook point; bowlBottom = contact with the floor
use: fall (loop) while dropping in its lane -> land once when it bites the floor (frame 2 = white spark, the only #ffffff px) -> hang (loop) for the 2 s it stays as an obstacle; draw the chain from the rail down to 'eye' with fx_boss_chain frame 1 (vertical tile)
